title: Brain AI Scientist: An Evidence-Based Multi-Agent System for Translational Neuroimaging in Precision Psychiatry
abstract: arXiv:2611.18634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) has revealed widespread brain-network alterations in psychiatric disorders, yet translating these findings into individualized clinical decision support remains challenging. Here we introduce Brain AI Scientist, an autonomous multi-agent framework that integrates patient-specific fMRI, clinical information, and scientific evidence through retrieval, verification, and prioritization. Guided by Research Domain Criteria and evidence-based medicine, it builds traceable chains linking phenotypes, anatomical abnormalities, biomarkers, mechanisms, interventions, and validation strategies. In a representative autism case, Brain AI Scientist generated 37 anatomical hypotheses, retained 26 after literature verification, and derived 65 evidence-supported biomarkers from 90 unique publications to generate patient-specific treatment and validation guidance. translated_abstract: 静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）已揭示精神疾病中广泛的脑网络改变，但将这些发现转化为个体化临床决策支持仍然具有挑战性。本文介绍了Brain AI Scientist（脑AI科学家），这是一个自主多智能体框架，通过检索、验证和优先级排序，整合患者特异性fMRI数据、临床信息和科学证据。在研究领域标准（RDoC）和循证医学的指导下，该系统构建了连接表型、解剖异常、生物标志物、机制、干预措施和验证策略的可追溯证据链条。在一个代表性的自闭症案例中，Brain AI Scientist生成了37个解剖学假设，经文献验证后保留了26个，并从90篇独立出版物中推导出65个有证据支持的生物标志物，从而生成患者特异性的治疗和验证指导。在17个自闭症谱系……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Brain AI Scientist——一个基于循证医学的多智能体自主系统，通过整合患者fMRI数据与科学文献的检索验证，构建可追溯的证据链，为精准精神病学生成个体化生物标志物和治疗指导。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Brain AI Scientist, an evidence-based multi-agent autonomous system that integrates patient-specific fMRI with literature retrieval and verification to build traceable evidence chains, enabling individualized biomarkers and treatment guidance for precision psychiatry.
